mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% in a 3-month window signals economic distress, triggering immediate equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts and consumer credit demand indicates weakening aggregate demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue expectations decline.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases over 3-year rolling windows, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY) trigger anticipated Federal Reserve tightening, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic activity and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1100 thousand units indicate a contracting housing sector, reducing consumer confidence and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 1100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) signals wage inflation pressure, prompting Fed tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE < 5.0% fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% QoQ) leads to stretched valuations and profit-taking, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic momentum peaks.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% QoQ, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
